name: f3router
tagline: Free LLM API router for your coding agents
summary: One OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint in front of many AI providers. Point Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Aider and other coding agents at it and it routes each request to a working provider, with automatic fallback when a quota runs out.

name: f3mote
tagline: Remote terminal for your coding agents
summary: Drive your dev workstation and its coding agents from a phone or browser: a remote terminal, file explorer, desktop stream and every AI harness in one UI.
